failureReason: The model attempted to implement URL data prefetching but failed to meet the test requirements. It created new components and modified files, but the implementation was missing critical features: (1) never added `partialPrefetching: true` to next.config.ts, (2) never added `use cache` directives to cache the category data, and (3) misunderstood how Partial Prefetching should work with searchParams and cached data. All 4 runs produced incomplete/incorrect code that failed the same tests.
